name: Godrej Lakeside Orchard
description: Godrej Lakeside Orchard is a residential project off Sarjapur Road in Kodathi village, planned around water and about 6 acres of greens. It offers 3, 3.5, and 4+ BHK homes with a clubhouse, a pool, and more than 40 amenities.
curation: About 6 acres of landscaped greens with 700+ trees
A clubhouse set beside the main pool
Close to RGA Tech Park, Market Square Mall, and Manipal Hospital
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
